title: Floor Falls
description: Form Experimental Premiere Status English Country United Kingdom Year 2020 Running Time 3min Language No Dialogue Director Jennifer Paterson, Lewis Gourlay, Abby Warrilow Producer All or Nothing Aerial Dance Theatre Key Cast Freya Jeffs Director of Photography Andrew Begg Editor Lewis Gourlay A woman stands, takes a breath, and moves. Rotating and twisting, she and the camera dance around each other. She suspends, or has the floor fallen? Shot in Abernethy Forest in The Cairngorms, Forest Floor considers different bodies and physical access challenges in a rural location. Close friends Julie and Robbie sit quietly together on the ground, a simple idea requiring a novel approach.
